create_table_visualization: create a matplotlib table from a pandas DataFrame or Series on a given axes
create_scatter_matrix: create a matrix of scatter plots for each pair of numeric columns in a DataFrame
create_radviz_plot: create a 2D multidimensional plot where each data point is positioned by its values across dimensions
create_parallel_coordinates: create parallel coordinates visualization connecting feature values across vertical axes colored by class
create_bootstrap_plot: create a bootstrap plot estimating uncertainty of mean, median, and mid-range statistics
